message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically covers about **380–400 miles** (≈ 610–640 km) along the I‑5 corridor. Under normal traffic conditions, you can expect the trip to take roughly **6 to 7 hours**. If you’re heading during rush hour or on weekends, it might take longer—sometimes up to 8–9 hours—so it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates before you depart.
